_what: Deliberately reproduced failures. Every claim in the README's findings section points at one of these, with the seed that produced it, so the limits are checkable rather than asserted. These are NOT part of the 85-entry catalog.

entries.claim: Text: a list of many strings collapses after the first few
entries.prompt: A cafe chalkboard, straight on, filled edge to edge with hand-lettered menu items in white and pale yellow chalk. Legible items include "FILTER 4.50", "CORTADO 4.00", "OAT +0.60". Slight chalk dust haze, uneven letter weights, a small drawn coffee cherry in the corner.

entries.claim: Text: twelve independent strings in one frame, all unreadable
entries.prompt: A tight row of twelve hardback book spines on a shelf, shot straight on so all titles are legible. Varying cloth colours and foil-stamped serif titles. Invent plausible titles in English. Even soft light, no glare on the foil, shallow depth so the spine faces are sharp and the shelf edge falls off.

entries.claim: Text: thirty station names, none of them words
entries.prompt: A stylised city transit map with four coloured lines, interchange stations shown as white circles with black outlines, and legible station names in a condensed sans-serif. 45-degree angles only, even line spacing, a small legend in the lower left.

entries.claim: Text: years render, labels do not
entries.prompt: A horizontal timeline spanning 1970 to 2030 with eight milestone markers above and below the axis alternately, each with a year and a short two-word label. Even tick spacing, one accent colour, plenty of white space, everything legible at a glance.

entries.claim: Text: Korean fails one character in, and looks clean if you cannot read it
entries.prompt: A hand-painted shopfront sign in Seoul reading exactly "정직한 국수" in a bold brush-drawn Korean typeface, white paint on a faded blue metal panel, weathered with rust bleeding from the screw heads. Straight-on documentary framing, overcast light, no other signage in frame.

entries.claim: Text: the command line renders, the output beneath it does not
entries.prompt: A photograph of a CRT monitor displaying a green-phosphor terminal, scanlines and slight bloom visible. The visible text reads "$ make install" followed by three lines of plausible build output. Shot at a slight angle so the glass curvature is apparent, dark room, the monitor is the only light source.
entries.expected: $ make install plus three lines of build output

entries.claim: Identity: at strength 0.72 the scene is new and the person is not the same
entries.prompt: The same woman from the reference sheet, now lit only by the blue glow of a laptop screen in a dark room. Same silver crop, same scar above the right eyebrow, same wire frames, same navy sweater. Identity must be unmistakably the same person.

entries.claim: Editing: asked to remove the steam, returns the steam
entries.prompt: Same mug, same table, same backlight. Remove the steam entirely and let the coffee surface go still and mirror-flat, reflecting the window.
